FIXED: was looking up the raw CIP code (e.g. '52.0201') directly against 'Program Master' without specifying which columns to match -- CIP codes aren't unique per program (BBA and MBA can share one), and without code_col/name_col the lookup was reading the wrong columns entirely, so it never resolved. Now derives from Grad_Program_Code instead: looks up the row in 'Program Master' whose CAA Program Code (column 3) matches, and takes that row's Program Name (column 5). NOTE: I haven't seen this form's Field Properties/Display Fields setting the way I confirmed it for the Enrollments form's equivalent field -- if Zoho actually expects a combo like 'CIP Code - Program Code' here too rather than just the Name, let me know the exact Display Fields configuration and I'll adjust (name_col/lookup_direction) to match.
